verdicts.reason: A keeps the can layered on its circle and reads left to right with a prominent CTA. Its flaws: the GLACIER wordmark floats centred over the headline column with no clear alignment, the circle is jammed against the left and bottom edges, and the badge/CTA cluster on the right is detached from the copy and leaves a dead gap. B breaks the key graphic by separating the empty circle on the left from the can on the far right, and puts GLACIER below the headline, which reverses the reading order. It also shrinks the CTA to the size of the badges and lower in contrast, so it is buried, and the body copy is tiny.
